title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0118e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.026600
  m_eff = 2.3590e-1 eV
  T_vev = 4.3611e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.3288 s⁻¹
  k = 0.2316 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.704511 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = 9.844e-3
  J_spin = 3.130e-3
